T: Put it on the Underhills' tab.
D: An undercover reporter investigating drug dealing gets a very strange offer from a millionaire.
P: Serve the mains when Fletch orders at the club on the Underhills' tab.
S: Country club Bloody Mary prawn cocktail

Chilled king prawns over shredded cos with a spicy Bloody Mary cocktail sauce of tomato, horseradish, Worcestershire and lemon. Peel 600g cooked king prawns, leaving the tails on. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp horseradish cream, 1 tsp Worcestershire, a few drops of hot sauce, 1/2 tsp celery salt and a squeeze of lemon. Shred 1 baby cos lettuce into 4 glasses. Spoon over some sauce, then hang the prawns around the rim. Dust with paprika and serve with lemon wedges and a celery stick.
Beach kiosk fish bites with lime aioli
Fletch undercover on the LA beach

Bite-size snapper pieces in a light, crisp batter, fried golden and served with a garlicky lime aioli and a sprinkle of chilli salt. Cut 500g snapper fillets into 3cm pieces. Whisk 120g plain flour, 30g cornflour, 1 tsp baking powder and 220ml cold soda water into a batter. Dip the fish and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp and golden, then drain. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and the zest and juice of 1 lime. Sprinkle the fish with sea salt and a pinch of chilli flakes and serve with the aioli.
M: Steak sandwich and a steak sandwich
the order put on the Underhills' tab

Thin seared rump on toasted Turkish bread with caramelised onions, melted Swiss cheese, rocket, tomato and hot English mustard mayo. Slowly fry 3 sliced onions in 30g butter and 1 tbsp brown sugar for 20 minutes until jammy. Bat 4 rump steaks to 1cm thick, season and sear in a very hot pan for 1 minute a side. Lay a slice of Swiss cheese on each and cover for 30 seconds to melt. Toast 4 halved Turkish rolls. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tsp hot English mustard. Build each with mayo, rocket, tomato, steak and onions. Make two each.
W: the country club Fletch talks his way into

Vanilla ice cream with homemade hot fudge sauce, whipped cream, toasted salted peanuts and a maraschino cherry in tall glasses. Heat 150ml thickened cream with 60g brown sugar and 30g butter until bubbling. Take off the heat and stir in 120g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of salt until smooth and glossy. Toast 60g salted peanuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes and chop. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 tall glasses. Pour over the warm fudge, top with whipped cream from 150ml cream, peanuts and a cherry.
K: the drinks charged to the Underhills

Vodka and tomato juice spiked with horseradish, Worcestershire, hot sauce and lemon, in a celery salt rimmed glass with a crunchy celery stick. Mix 1 tbsp celery salt with 1 tsp cracked pepper on a saucer, wet the rims of 4 tall glasses with lemon and dip. Fill with ice. In a jug, stir 800ml tomato juice with 180ml vodka, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 tsp horseradish cream, 2 tsp Worcestershire and 6 dashes hot sauce. Pour into the glasses and add a celery stick and a lemon wedge. Leave out the vodka for a Virgin Mary.
